stops.name: Parco dell'Adda Nord
stops.detail: The park of the North Adda is a protected natural area that includes the plain territories crossed by the Adda River, downstream of the Lecchese branch of the Lario. In this part the river winds through a unique landscape with unique environmental characteristics. The park was established in 1983 and has an area of 5580 hectares.
